tested_states.description: AZ1 (Orthosteric Boltz-2 pose) vs Lactate (8Z8A Co-crystal)
tested_states.steric_consequence: Direct spatial penetration into the identical Arg71 binding subpocket; complete mutual exclusion.

tested_states.description: AZ1 (Allosteric Vina pose) vs Lactate (8Z8A Co-crystal)
tested_states.steric_consequence: Even in an exosite pose, the bulky tail of AZ1 (MW 603) penetrates the orthosteric vestibule and clashes with Lactate at 0.83 A.

pharmacological_verdict: AZ1 cannot co-exist with Lactate under any binding mode on a single protomer. It is a strictly competitive orthosteric agonist that physically displaces endogenous lactate.
